atoms.text: This is the Jones family. They are inside the terminal building of Heathrow Airport. However, the terminal is a very big building where you can easily get lost. That is why there are many signs telling you where to go. Let’s have a look at one of these signs.

atoms.a: This sign tells you where aeroplanes are landing.
This sign tells you where aeroplanes are taking off.
This sign tells you where you can pick up your luggage.
This sign tells you where you have to go to change planes.
This sign tells you where you have to go in order to check in and get your boarding pass.

instruction.text: Listen to the question and select the correct answer with the help of the sign.

atoms.a: I need to find my connecting flight. Where do I have to go?

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_2025'>In order to transfer to another plane, you have to take a slight left.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_2025'>If you want to transfer to another plane, you should take a right.</voice>

atoms.a: Excuse me, I want to pick up my suitcase. Where do I have to go?

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_2025'>The baggage reclaim is to your right.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f2'>To get to the baggage reclaim, first, you have to turn around and then take a left.</voice>

atoms.a: Hi, I’m running late! My plane is taking off very soon. Where do I have to go?

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>No problem, just take a right here, and you will find the departures.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_2025'>Just keep on walking straight. The departures are straight ahead, you can’t miss it.</voice>

instruction.text: Listen to the stops the Jones family makes before they take off. Find and select the correct object on the picture.

atoms.a: First, the Jones family drives from their house to the airport in their red car.
They try to find a parking spot in the car park next to the big building.
Then they go into the terminal and get ready for their flight.
Finally, they can board the aircraft and get ready for take off.
